model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between an unspecified variable on the x-axis and "Informativeness" on the y-axis, comparing two conditions: "w.o. extension" and "extension". The x-axis is unlabeled, has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 4, and has tick labels at intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "Informativeness", has a linear scale, ranges from 0.920 to 0.970, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.01. The blue dashed line with circular markers represents "w.o. extension" and starts at approximately 0.968 when the x-axis value is 0, decreasing steadily to around 0.916 when the x-axis value is 4. The orange solid line with triangular markers represents "extension" and begins at roughly 0.968 when the x-axis value is 0, also decreasing steadily to about 0.921 when the x-axis value is 4, with both lines showing a consistent downward trend across the x-axis range.
